exercises.q: Match each word with its meaning (Wiktionary's definitions).
pairs: ascent, rise (act of ascending; motion upwards)
exercises.why: From Wiktionary: вы́ходка — trick, prank; восхожде́ние — ascent, rise (act of ascending; motion upwards); прихо́жая — vestibule, hall, antechamber; восхо́д — rise.
**выходка** — вы́ходка: trick, prank; freak, escapade, antics. Wiktionary: выходи́ть + -ка.
